name: cheapergen-dev
description: Integrate the CheaperGen API into your code: official video and image models from the major labs below their official prices. Includes the cheapergen-api skill (API keys, endpoints, quotes, polling and webhooks, errors) and the read-only CheaperGen Developer MCP server for looking up models, input schemas, prices and price comparisons while you build. The MCP server never generates media or spends credits.
